name: Mochaen
text: Mochaen is a corrupt form of Miodhchaoin, the ogre guarding a hill in northern Lochlainn. The corrupted spelling turns up in lists beside the parent form.

attributes.attribute: corrupt spelling carried by the Lochlainn ogre

okr.objective: Documents Mochaen as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Mochaen is a corrupted spelling of Miodhchaoin.
The ogre watches over a hill in northern Lochlainn.
